newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine telecoms upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine telecoms upgraded.

text.p: - Paribas Capital Markets telecoms analyst William Beavington said he upgraded the ADRs of Argentina's Telecom and Telefnica to "buy" from a 12-month-old "hold".
- The Paribas analyst said the Argentine telephone tariff overhaul that emerged Thursday "lifts a cloud of uncertainty" over the companies.
- He said the improved competitiveness it will give them for the opening up of the Argentine telecoms market in 2000 "gives an improved sense of earnings visibility."
- But it is unlikely that the tariff rebalancing will bring any improvement in earnings, he said.
